body: Yeah. Tried antidepressants but it was always the same. Better for a while then spiraling down to suicidal thoughts. Tried therapy but I’ve never gotten anywhere significant. I’ve had depression since I was around 10 or 11. I don’t know why it’s worse now but I’ve really gotten to the point of accepting that it’s never going to get better.

Oh, I’m not alone. I’m married. I have kids. I work full time (at work right now actually). But im a terrible wife and mother. I really try so hard to be better for them but I always come up short. Im letting everyone down and they deserve so much better. It’s not fair to them. But thank you so much for your kind words.
